message: The paper reports a MetaHIT/iHMP sequencing experiment in Section 4.3 and Table 3, but that section does not identify exact samples, split manifests or construction of its taxonomic reference labels. The five-fold procedure in Section 4.2 is described for different text/image datasets and cannot safely be assigned to this result. The printed score is retained; protocol identity remains unresolved and the row is excluded from comparisons.
source_locator: Section 4.2 Experimental details versus the additional metagenomic experiment in Section 4.3 and Table 3
